title: The capacity region of the general two-way channel
formal: Characterize the capacity region of an arbitrary finite-alphabet discrete memoryless two-way channel when each terminal's current input may depend on its own message and past received outputs.
context:
Restricting encoders to ignore past outputs changes the achievable region and is not the general adaptive problem.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Determines the fundamental value of interaction in simultaneous bidirectional communication.
